title: Tundra World
description: All-frozen overworld: glaciers, ice spikes, snowfields and frozen seas. Built on Isekai API.
body:
**The overworld frozen end to end.** Glaciers, ice spikes, snowfields, and frozen seas under a pale winter sky — one continuous cold world. Powered by Isekai API.

## What it does

Tundra World recolours the whole overworld into a snow-and-ice biome set distributed by climate band — frozen ocean, snowy plains, ice spikes, snowy taiga, and frozen peaks — so every region reads as a different shade of winter. Vanilla terrain, ores, structures, and mobs still generate underneath.

## Features

**All-frozen overworld** — the entire surface is snow, ice, and glacier, banded by continentalness so it varies from frozen sea to icy peak.

**Vanilla content preserved** — ores, structures, and mobs still generate; this is a biome reskin, not an empty world.

## Requirements

**Isekai API is required** — Tundra World is a worldshape built on Isekai's worldgen primitives.

## Compatibility

Coexists with TerraBlender, YUNG's structure mods, map mods, and dimension mods. Mutually exclusive with other overworld-overhaul mods — only one mod can own the overworld; no crash, last-loaded wins.

## License & links

**Related projects**

- [Isekai API](https://modrinth.com/mod/isekai-api) — required worldgen framework these worlds are built on
- [Mountain World](https://modrinth.com/mod/mountain-world) — sister world: the overworld reforged as endless mountains
- [Sky World](https://modrinth.com/mod/sky-world) — sister world: the overworld as a vertical sea of floating islands
- [Tropical World](https://modrinth.com/mod/tropical-world) — sister world: the overworld as a sunlit tropical sea with sandy islets
